title: SafeExplorer: An Unbiased Mixed-Policy Gradient for Reinforcement Learning with Recovery Interventions
abstract: arXiv:2607.08925v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training agents directly on the task they will be deployed on often leads to the best policy performance, but training on physical robots can cause damage through falls, so minimizing training falls is critical. A standard mitigation hands control to a separate recovery policy whenever the agent leaves a designer-specified safe region. The resulting mixed-policy rollouts bias the on-policy update, and importance sampling cannot remove this bias when the recovery policy is deterministic. We propose SafeExplorer, a drop-in modification of proximal policy optimization (PPO) built on an unbiased policy-gradient estimator of the mixed-policy return. The estimator uses the score function only inside the safe region and never evaluates the recovery policy's density, so deterministic recovery policies pose no problem. translated_title: SafeExplorer：一种用于带恢复干预的强化学习的无偏混合策略梯度
translated_abstract: 直接在智能体将要部署的任务上进行训练通常能带来最佳的策略性能，但在物理机器人上训练可能因跌倒而造成设备损坏，因此最小化训练过程中的跌倒次数至关重要。一种标准的缓解方法是在智能体离开设计者指定的安全区域时，将控制权移交给一个单独的恢复策略。由此产生的混合策略轨迹会使在线策略更新产生偏差，而当恢复策略为确定性策略时，重要性采样无法消除这种偏差。我们提出了 SafeExplorer，这是对近端策略优化（PPO）的一种即插即用式修改，其建立在混合策略回报的无偏策略梯度估计器之上。该估计器仅在安全区域内使用得分函数，从不评估恢复策略的概率密度，因此确定性恢复策略不会构成问题。在最终奖励方面，该估计器的表现与截断重要性采样相当或更优，而后者在同样的梯度估计中本身就是有偏的。
tldr: 提出 SafeExplorer，一种基于混合策略回报无偏梯度估计器的 PPO 即插即用改进方法，即使在使用确定性恢复策略进行安全强化学习训练时也能消除在线策略更新偏差。
en_tdlr: SafeExplorer is a drop-in PPO modification built on an unbiased policy-gradient estimator for mixed-policy returns, eliminating on-policy update bias in safe RL training even when using deterministic recovery policies.
